rv.q: In other words, as we emerge from the darkness ravenous for uncomplicated, transporting spectacle, it feels just right for right now.
Laurence Connor’s buoyant revival of Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice’s Biblical musical charmed audiences back in 2019, and remains an absolute winner.

cn.t: Lloyd Webber and Rice's biblical musical charms in Laurence Connor's buoyant revival, proving itself an absolute winner with infectious energy and polished choreography.
